item.name: 1/2/4Pcs Safety Pinless Bed Sheet Cover Fastener Clips / Anti-run Bedsheet Grippers Fixed Holder
item.title: 1/2/4Pcs Safety Pinless Bed Sheet Cover Fastener Clips / Anti-run Bedsheet Grippers Fixed Holder
item.description:
✿✿✿ Hi ! Welcome to My Store ! ✿✿✿
 
 -----------------------------------------------------
 
 ✿✿✿ Package Description ✿✿✿
 
 
 Description
 【INNOVATIVE DESIGN FOR PERFECT FIT】: Discover the perfect solution to keep your bed linens secure with our Invisible Bed Sheet and Duvet Fixator. Made from high-quality ABS+PP materials, this seamless clip ensures your sheets stay in place without visible pins or clips, offering a neat and polished look.
 【EASY TO INSTALL AND REMOVE】: Effortlessly attach the fixator to your mattress edge in seconds using its non-damaging, adjustable mechanism. Simply slide it into place and enjoy a secure fit—no need for complicated installation or harmful staples.
 【MULTI-PURPOSE AND COMPATIBLE】: Perfect for both bed sheets and duvets, this fixator is designed to work with various mattress sizes and types. Its compact size (approx. 9.8*8.8*11cm) makes it versatile for use in bedrooms, guest rooms, or even travel.
 【DURABLE AND LONG-LASTING】: Built with durable ABS+PP materials, this fixator withstands daily use without losing its grip or shape. Available in white and gray, it blends seamlessly with any bedding style while maintaining its functionality.
 【SAVE TIME AND EFFORT】: Say goodbye to wrinkles, bunches, and constant readjustments. This fixator keeps your bed looking tidy and well-made, saving you time and effort while enhancing your sleep experience.
 
 Specifications
 Material: ABS+PP
 Category: Sheet and bed cover holder
 Color: white, gray
 Size: about 9.8*8.8*11cm
 Applicable: Multifunctional invisible sheet and bed cover holder, needle-free bed sheet anti-shifting fixing artifact
 Package includes: 1/2/4sets*Bed Sheet Fixer
 
 
 -----------------------------------------------------
